# For the pinned harness's KB validator in the PR workflow. Installed with --require-hashes and --only-binary, so a
# changed file on PyPI fails the install rather than running. The hashes are the cp312 and cp314 manylinux x86_64
# wheels, the runner's system Python before and after ubuntu-latest moved to 3.14. A runner on another Python fails
# the hash check, which is the signal to add that wheel's hash.
pyyaml==6.0.3 \
    --hash=sha256:ba1cc08a7ccde2d2ec775841541641e4548226580ab850948cbfda66a1befcdc \
    --hash=sha256:c458b6d084f9b935061bc36216e8a69a7e293a2f1e68bf956dcd9e6cbcd143f5
